summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10) via systemd units, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380, and verified cross-member read/write consistency. Demonstrated availability during a member outage (stopped node3, wrote/read via node1+node2 quorum) and confirmed node3 caught up fully on restart. Completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes, verifying changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.7.1 binaries (etcd, etcdctl, etcdutl) to /usr/local/bin on node1, node2, node3 via GitHub release tarball
Created etcd system user and /var/lib/etcd data dir on each node
Wrote systemd unit /etc/systemd/system/etcd.service on each node with correct per-node name/peer-URL and shared initial-cluster string
Opened firewalld ports 2379/tcp and 2380/tcp permanently on all three nodes
Enabled and started etcd on all three nodes; confirmed 3/3 members healthy and started via member list/endpoint health
Wrote 'foo' from node1, read from node2 and node3; wrote 'baz' from node2, read from node3 and node1 - confirmed cross-member replication
Stopped etcd on node3 to simulate a member outage; wrote/read key 'during-outage' via node1+node2 quorum while node3 was down
Restarted etcd on node3; verified it caught up to the same raft applied index as node1/node2 and could read the key written during its outage
Captured baseline boot_id and etcd health on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time, quorum preserved), polling each until reachable again

Verified changed boot_id on each node post-reboot, confirmed etcd service reactivated, and confirmed full 3/3 cluster health, membership, and all previously written keys (foo, baz, during-outage) after each restart

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster formed on node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: member list and endpoint health from node1 show all three members (node1/node2/node3) started and healthy

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: 'foo' written on node1, read back on node2 and node3; 'baz' written on node2, read back on node3 and node1

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped, then a write and read of 'during-outage' succeeded using only node1+node2 endpoints while node3 was down

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted; endpoint status shows matching raft applied index (16) across all three members and node3 successfully reads 'during-outage' written while it was down

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 8f258838... and etcd endpoint health=true before reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; node became unreachable then returned with new boot_id c282648b...; etcd reactivated (active) and cluster health/data (during-outage, foo) confirmed intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id 21de1f79... and etcd endpoint health=true before reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable then returned with new boot_id 305efbdc...; etcd reactivated and cluster health/data (baz) confirmed intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart (second restart of node3, post-recovery test): healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node3 boot_id 83a0a80f... and etcd endpoint health=true before reboot (after earlier stop/start recovery test)

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect, changed boot identity, recovered state and full cluster quorum/membership
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable then returned with new boot_id 56713fab...; etcd reactivated, member list shows all 3 members started, endpoint health 3/3 true, and all keys (foo, baz, during-outage) readable
